name: Gupta Media
employeeCountSource: Company LinkedIn profile, accessed 2026-11-11; company-size range rather than an audited headcount.
description: Boston-based Gupta Media describes itself as a strategic consultancy and performance marketing agency offering creative strategy, digital media, and analytics. An expert-network offering could not be verified in the public sources reviewed.
keyDifferentiators: Company-described combination of creative strategy, media, and analytics
Company-developed Report(SE) reporting and Tally ticketing analytics tools
overview: Gupta Media is based in Boston and describes its business as a strategic consultancy combining creative strategy, digital media, advanced analytics, and performance marketing. Its public technology materials describe marketing reporting and ticketing analytics tools. The expert-call service and expert database previously described in this profile were not substantiated by the sources reviewed.

history.narrative: Company sources disagree on the founding year, so no founding year is displayed. Recent announcements concern its marketing agency business.

timeline.event: Reported inclusion in the Boston Globe's 2025 Top Places to Work list.
Reported ranking 54th overall on ADWEEK's 2026 Fastest Growing Agencies list.
Announced its appointment as the USGA's paid media agency of record, covering strategy, planning, buying, reporting, and audience measurement. MediaPost also reported the appointment.

servicesDetailed.name: Digital Media and Creative Strategy
servicesDetailed.description: The company describes creative campaigns and media planning; its USGA announcement also specifies paid media strategy, planning, buying, and reporting.

servicesDetailed.name: Marketing Analytics
servicesDetailed.description: Gupta Media says Report(SE) provides marketing performance reporting and that its analytics team builds custom dashboards combining media metrics with business results.

servicesDetailed.name: Ticketing Analytics
servicesDetailed.description: The company describes Tally as a tool for ticket-sales reporting and predictive modeling for festivals and live events.

clientFit.narrative: Editorial assessment based on the company's published services: relevant to buyers seeking marketing execution and analytics. Expert-network research services remain unverified.

strengths: Company-described creative strategy, media, and analytics services
Company-described marketing reporting and ticketing analytics tools
caveats: Expert calls and a 20,000-professional network could not be verified in the public materials reviewed.
Expert-network pricing, vetting, MNPI policies, and audit-trail capabilities were not established by the reviewed sources.
Company sources give inconsistent founding years.
notableFacts: Appointed the USGA's paid media agency of record in October 2026, as reported by MediaPost.
sourceNotes: https://www.guptamedia.com/about-us — Accessed 2026-11-11. Describes an advertising agency and consultancy offering creative strategy, digital media, analytics, and performance marketing, with technology, consumer-brand, music, festival, and sports clients; does not establish the previous expert-network identity.

https://www.linkedin.com/company/gupta-media — Accessed 2026-11-11. Company profile lists Boston headquarters, a 51–200 employee range, and a 2001 founding year. Headcount is company-stated, not independently verified.

https://www.guptamedia.com/technology — Accessed 2026-11-11. Describes Report(SE), custom reporting, Tally, and a CPM Tracker. These marketing tools do not substantiate the removed expert-matching, AI sentiment-analysis, expert-database, pricing, or compliance claims.

https://www.guptamedia.com/insights/gogi-gupta-named-to-boston-magazines-2026-most-influential-bostonians-list — Accessed 2026-11-11. April 28, 2026 article says founded in 2003, conflicting with company LinkedIn's 2001 and 2026 anniversary messaging; removed unsupported 2004 and left founding year unset.

https://www.guptamedia.com/insights/gupta-media-2025-top-places-to-work-boston-globe — Accessed 2026-11-11. December 3, 2025 announcement reports Boston Globe workplace recognition and a forthcoming 25th anniversary in 2026. Recognition retained as company-reported.

https://www.guptamedia.com/insights/what-does-it-take-to-keep-growing-after-25-years-gupta-media-named-to-adweeks-fastest-growing-agencies-list — Accessed 2026-11-11. October 9, 2026 announcement reports 54th overall on ADWEEK's 2026 Fastest Growing Agencies list. Ranking is company-stated; linked ADWEEK pages could not be read.

https://www.guptamedia.com/insights/usga-selects-gupta-media-paid-media-agency-record — Accessed 2026-11-11. October 16, 2026 announcement details the USGA appointment, paid media scope, audience strategy, first-party data integration, and Tally ticketing analytics.

https://www.mediapost.com/publications/article/418779/usga-selects-gupta-media-as-its-paid-media-aor.html — Accessed 2026-11-11. Independently reports the USGA appointment and ticket-sales remit. No reviewed public source substantiated the former clean-regulatory-record assertion; removed it rather than equating missing evidence with a clean record.
